evidence: Pairwise review of all 52 scored criteria (42 functional, 5 polish, 5 visual) plus the 2 zero-weight gates. Most of the task is carefully partitioned with explicit ownership clauses: hro_arrive_bottom defers multi-card arrival to hro_bulk_move; hro_interview_full defers bulk overfill to hro_bulk_places and undo overfill to hro_undo_full; hro_undo_restores defers the A2 undo to hro_undo_conflict; hro_drafts defers post-send clearing to hro_msg_compose; hro_pol_failed_send defers note drafts to hro_pol_session_resume; hro_pol_live_thread defers scrolled-up placement to Functional (hro_unread_scrolled_up); hro_candidate_view defers leaks to hro_candidate_private and the candidate reply to hro_msg_exchange; hro_candidate_linked owns the email link; Activity lines from refused actions are deducted only in hro_activity_refusals (functional/prompt.md:19). No pair demands incompatible products: checked against hireops_rules.md (e.g. hro_undo_conflict B(14) 're-orders one such card' refuses undo while B(12) re-order of a DIFFERENT card (Y) lets undo proceed, consistent with rules.md:98-100; hro_drafts reload persistence vs hro_msg_compose 'after a reload the sent text does not reappear' are compatible per rules.md:175; candidate 403/404 in hro_refusal_status matches rules.md:21-23 and hro_candidate_private 'not found'). Visual likert rows (type/color/layout/hierarchy/consistency) are distinct axes and the visual prompt says do not deduct one defect twice. DEFECT: hro_refusal_status (functional/judge.toml:195-201) overlaps the acceptance leg of hro_observer_readonly (:167-174), hro_candidate_no_staff (:176-183), hro_thread_access (:365-372, Observer/Ingrid send replays) and hro_stale_refused (:203-210). It says 'Only the status is graded here; whether anything changed is graded in those rows', but separates only the side-effect leg, not the refused-vs-accepted leg. hro_refusal_status requires each R/T/C replay to be 'refused with 403' (or 409 for C) and 'Fails if any of these refusals carries another status'; the sibling rows fail when the same replay 'is accepted'. A 2xx acceptance of one replay is therefore deducted in two rows, which directly conflicts with the prompt's own rule 'Never deduct one observed defect in more than one row' (functional/prompt.md:23) without saying which row keeps the deduction, so the judge's outcome on that observation is ambiguous/variable. Secondary (Note, policy-mandated, not counted as the Fail): control dependencies cascade one broken feature into several rows, e.g. hro_candidate_no_staff 'Fails if ... the staff control did not succeed' (Rafael's undo/multi-card move/note), hro_anonymous 'A signed-in success of each is the control', hro_observer_readonly 'Rafael's identical successful requests are the control', hro_mgr_early_refused using late-stage moves as control; and hro_pol_live_board / hro_pol_live_thread are 0 when no live update arrives (also failing hro_live_board / hro_msg_exchange). REVIEW_POLICY 'A negative needs a successful control... A dead feature must not earn credit' requires this, so it is not treated as duplicate grading here, but it is in tension with the same prompt line 23 and with REVIEW_POLICY 'Preserve valid observations rather than inheriting a sibling verdict'; granularity belongs to rows 26/30/33. hro_job_open's 'evidenced by behaviour (the manager's own moves in R, the places limit in L)' is an alternative to display ('wherever the app shows job details'), so it does not by itself re-grade L/R. Runtime: no configured judge run exists (raw-evidence-index scope says full configured grading is absent), so whether the judge actually double-deducts is NOT EXERCISED; the finding is a source-level overlap.
counterexample: Plausible broken app: role check missing for the Observer, so Aud's replayed single-card move returns 200 and moves the card (or a stale replay in C is applied with 200). That one observation fails hro_observer_readonly ('Fails if any request is accepted') AND hro_refusal_status ('refused with 403' not met; 200 is another status), and for C fails hro_stale_refused AND hro_refusal_status -- one defect deducted twice (weight 1 extra each), contrary to prompt.md:23. Conversely a judge obeying prompt.md:23 may pass hro_refusal_status vacuously ('no refusal carried another status') for the same app, so two judges diverge on identical evidence.
suggested_fix: In hro_refusal_status grade only the status of replays that were actually refused (non-2xx) and state that an accepted replay is deducted only in its own row (hro_observer_readonly, hro_candidate_no_staff, hro_thread_access, hro_stale_refused), so no acceptance is counted twice.
